title: make repin can pin a local sandbox build that has no image
foundBy: session agent, reviewing how local builds reach images (tasks/pin-on-local-builds.md, section 7)
details: The smoke and live tiers boot the image the pinned cs-sandbox names. `make repin` takes sandbox's newest local build as soon as its `make ci` passes, whether or not an image of it exists. CI's status file waits for both images before it lists a commit. A campaign member cannot build a full image at all, since Firecracker needs /dev/kvm.
